claims.claim_text: On November 2, 2025, IREN entered into the 'Microsoft Agreement' with Microsoft Corporation to provide dedicated GPU services in tranches at Childress, Texas data center facilities over an average term of approximately 5 years, with a total contract value of approximately $9.7 billion, with 20% of the contract value to be paid prior to each tranche's applicable delivery date. As of March 31, 2026, zero tranches had been delivered and accepted, and no Microsoft consideration is included in the $710.3M unsatisfied RPO. A delayed-draw $3.6B GPU financing facility from Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan to support the Microsoft Agreement was committed (binding commitment letter Feb 4, 2026) but remained subject to definitive documentation.

claims.claim_text: As of March 31, 2026 IREN has seven data center sites with executed grid connection agreements (or LOAs / equivalents) representing 4,510MW of total power capacity: Childress TX (750MW), Sweetwater 1 TX (1,400MW), Sweetwater 2 TX (600MW), one Oklahoma site (1,600MW), Canal Flats BC (30MW), Mackenzie BC (80MW), Prince George BC (50MW). The 10-K from Sep 2025 had only listed 2,910MW of secured grid-connected power, so the Oklahoma 1,600MW addition is new since FY25 year-end and represents the bulk of the new headline MW figure.

claims.claim_text: IREN is developing four liquid-cooled AI data centers at Childress, Texas (Horizon 1, Horizon 2, Horizon 3 and Horizon 4) to support the Microsoft Agreement. Horizon 1 (originally announced Feb 12, 2025 at up to 50MW IT load, later expanded to 75MW in the 10-K's Properties table) was targeting energization by end of calendar year 2025. As of March 31, 2026, no Microsoft tranche has been delivered or accepted.

claims.claim_text: IREN's NVIDIA GPU fleet on order or installed is approximately 150,000 GPUs as of March 31, 2026, up from approximately 10.9k GPUs (1.9k H100/H200 + 5.5k B200 + 2.3k B300 + 1.2k GB300) targeted for end of CY2025 in the FY25 10-K. The huge increase corresponds to the Microsoft Agreement and includes the March 4, 2026 Dell purchase agreements totaling approximately $3.5 billion ($2.3B Dell Canada + $1.2B Dell USA) for GPUs and ancillary products and services to be delivered in tranches during H2 CY2026.

claims.claim_text: IREN's total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2026 was $144.8 million, essentially flat vs $144.8 million in the same period prior year, despite the company's marketing pivot to AI Cloud Services. The company recorded a net loss of $(247.8) million in the quarter and $(18.6) million for the nine months ended March 31, 2026, vs net loss of $(16.1) million in the prior-year quarter. Adjusted EBITDA was $59.5 million in the quarter vs $83.1 million prior year, a decline. The vast majority of recognized revenue is still from Bitcoin mining, not AI Cloud Services.

claims.claim_text: IREN is funding the AI-DC pivot primarily via massive convertible-note issuance and dilutive equity. As of March 31, 2026, convertible notes total $3.69B carrying value across five tranches (2029/2030/2031/2032/2033 Notes). The 2031 ($1.0B), 2032 ($1.15B) and 2033 ($1.15B) notes were issued in Oct-Dec 2025, $3.3B of new convertible paper in one quarter. On May 14, 2026 (post-quarter, pre-cutoff), an additional $3.0B 1.00% 2031 Convertible was issued. At-the-market equity has issued $635.1M as of Aug 15, 2025 with $364.9M remaining capacity. Capital structure is increasingly levered and dilutive.

claims.claim_text: On May 4, 2026 IREN signed a merger agreement to acquire Mirantis, Inc. (US cloud software/services) for ~$625M, primarily in IREN stock. On May 7, 2026 it signed a sale-and-purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Ingenostrum, S.L. (Nostrum Group), a Spanish data center developer, for ~EUR 165M (~65% cash / 35% stock), adding ~490MW of Spanish power capacity. Two M&A transactions in the four days immediately preceding the May 11-14 $3B convertible offering.

claims.claim_text: Sweetwater 1 (1,400MW) substation energization is targeted for Q2 CY2026; Sweetwater 2 (600MW) targeted for Q4 CY2027. As of June 30, 2025 IREN had paid $11.7M connection deposits for Sweetwater 1 and $13.5M deposits + $4.1M non-refundable connection costs for Sweetwater 2, with up to $13.5M more in Sweetwater 2 connection deposits due in the next 12 months. ERCOT batching of large-load interconnection requests is flagged as a risk.
